items.title: Welsh glamping owner loses driveway row over missing map letter; £135k bill
items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: Carol Esteban, owner of a glamping site, is grappling with a hefty £135,000 legal bill stemming from a contentious boundary dispute with neighbors Neil and Nadine Gould. The court has granted the Goulds a right of way to their parking area, dismissing Esteban's claims. Currently, her legal team is appealing this decision, as the ruling's implications may significantly impact both the right of way and her financial obligations.

items.title: Watch: Russian warship bursts into flames amid suspected Ukraine drone attack in Libya
items.author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
items.description: A suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack targeted a Russian warship at the Benghazi port, causing significant damage. Reports indicate that two drones successfully struck the corvette Merkury while it was docked to refuel. Libyan officials confirmed the incident and conducted an investigation into the attack's origin. Additionally, another drone attack occurred on a Malta-flagged commercial vessel off the coast.

items.title: Delhi's Tanjot Singh wins INSPIRE award for wool-and-cotton HEPA alternative
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Tanjot Singh from Delhi Public School developed an innovative air filtration system using compressed wool felt and electrostatic cotton. His project aimed to provide a sustainable alternative to synthetic HEPA filters commonly used for air purification. Tanjot initiated this project under the INSPIRE-MANAK programme, gaining recognition for its environmental benefits. He received mentorship at IIT Delhi to refine his research and prototype development.

items.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' $325M stadium investment fuels NWSL title success
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Kansas City Current's first NWSL Championship rewarded its owners' long-term investment in women's soccer infrastructure. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes were part of the ownership group that backed the club's purpose-built stadium and training facility. Angie Long said the facilities gave the team a sense of permanence and relevance. The Current's 2-1 victory over Washington Spirit turned that vision into a historic achievement, highlighting the value of building a strong foundation for success.
